# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

The public surface of Tess Core. Names listed here are covered by the stability
promise: they change only with a version bump and a note in the changelog. Anything
you import from a deeper module path is internal and may change without notice.

A test in the repository checks that every name on this page is importable from its
entry point, and that nothing leaves the surface by accident.

## Start here

The names most applications use. The guides explain each one.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `start_runtime` | Start a runtime on a runtime home. The one call an embedding application needs first. |
| `Runtime` | A started runtime: `sessions`, `scheduler`, `status()`, `inspect()`, `stop()`. |
| `Session` | One open conversation: `run_turn`, `subscribe`, `cancel_turn`, `close`, `end`. |
| `SessionOptions` | How a session is set up: provider, model, tools, permission mode, MCP servers, prompts. |
| `Unavailable` | Returned by your `session_options` function when a session cannot be opened right now. |
| `ToolDefinition` | A tool the model can call: name, description, input schema and an async handler. |
| `ProviderRegistry` | A loaded provider registry. Pass one, or a path to its YAML file, to `start_runtime`. |
| `ExecutionBudget` | A shared ceiling on model calls, tool calls and time across turns. |
| `MonitorDeliveryController` | Lets a host claim, publish and settle monitor deliveries on its own channels. |
| `SessionBusy` | Raised when a turn is started on a session that is already running one. |
| `SessionEnded` | Raised when a session that has been ended is used again. |
| `UnknownSessionError` | Raised when a session id does not exist in the runtime home. |
| `RuntimeStopped` | Raised when a stopped runtime is used. |

### Types

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `class AnthropicMessage` | One conversation message in Anthropic wire shape. |
| `class AnthropicUsage` | Normalized usage (snake_case on both providers; cache keys Anthropic-only). |
| `class AskQuestionDetail` | Context sent to the host with a question. For a permission prompt: the tool, mode, summary and reason. |
| `class ChildAgentRecord` | Child-agent record at ``agents/{agentId}.json``. |
| `class ExecutionBudget` | A ceiling on model calls, tool calls and elapsed time, shared by every turn it is given to. |
| `class ExecutionBudgetExceeded` | No further work may be admitted. |
| `class MonitorDeliveryController` | Host consumer bound to an explicit runtime home and native session IDs. |
| `class MonitorDeliveryError` | A monitor delivery was refused. ``code`` says why, for example ``monitor.not_found``. |
| `PermissionMode` | The permission modes: `default`, `acceptEdits`, `auto`, `dontAsk`, `bypassPermissions`. |
| `class ProviderRegistry` | Load a YAML providerProfiles (or profiles) mapping from an explicit path. |
| `class ProviderRegistryError` | A redacted registry/profile/credential configuration error. |
| `class ResolvedConfig` | Output of resolve_config (config/resolution.py). |
| `class Runtime` | A started runtime. Build it with :func:`start_runtime`. |
| `class RuntimeActivationContext` | RuntimeActivationContext(binding: 'RuntimeSessionBinding', session: 'Mapping[str, Any]', config: 'Mapping[str, Any]', tools: 'tuple[Any, ...]', slashCommands: 'tuple[Any, ...]', workspace: 'Any', p... |
| `class RuntimeEventEnvelope` | The exact shape emitted by create_runtime_event — every key always present. |
| `class RuntimeOwnershipError` | Another live process, or this one, already owns the runtime home. |
| `RuntimeSecretPurpose` | What a stored secret is for, such as a provider API key or an OAuth token. |
| `class RuntimeSecretRef` | An opaque reference to a secret the runtime holds. It carries no secret material. |
| `RuntimeSecretValue` | A secret given either as a literal value or as a `RuntimeSecretRef`. |
| `class RuntimeSessionBinding` | RuntimeSessionBinding(sessionId: 'str', generation: 'int', configRevision: 'int', runtimeInstanceId: 'str' = 'standalone', pathGraphId: 'str' = 'unbound') |
| `class RuntimeStopped` | The runtime is stopping or stopped: it takes no new sessions or turns. |
| `class Session` | A stable handle: the session's id plus the manager. |
| `class SessionBusy` | The session has a turn running or queued; close never cancels. |
| `class SessionEnded` | The session was ended, the one explicit instruction: it never reopens and takes no more work. |
| `class SessionManager` | The runtime's sessions, reached as ``runtime.sessions``. |
| `class SessionOptions` | How one session is set up. Everything is optional; the runtime home is the runtime's and the workspace defaults to the runtime's cwd. |
| `class SessionRecord` | Hydrated live session contract returned by storage loaders. |
| `class SessionUnavailableError` | Raised when the host's ``session_options`` answered ``Unavailable`` for a session. |
| `class ToolDefinition` | ToolDefinition(name: 'str', description: 'str', inputSchema: 'dict[str, Any]', handler: 'Callable[[dict[str, Any], ToolContext], Awaitable[ToolResult]]', concurrency: 'ToolConcurrency \| None' = Non... |
| `class Unavailable` | The host refuses or defers opening this session. |
| `class UnknownSessionError` | No session with that id exists in the runtime home. |

## `tess_core.shell_surface`

Extra names for applications that build an interactive shell around the runtime.

### Functions

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `def build_transcript_snapshot(session: dict[str, Any], limit: int \| None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]` | Render a session's messages as display entries: text, and tool results grouped by tool. |
| `def compact_model_name(model: str) -> str` | A shorter model name for status lines. |
| `async def create_debug_bundle(args: dict[str, Any] \| None = None) -> dict[str, Any]` | Write a diagnostic bundle for a session to a directory and return its manifest and path. |
| `def estimate_encoded_image_request_bytes(mimeType: str, decodedBytes: int) -> int` | An upper estimate of the bytes an image adds to a request once base64-encoded. |
| `def format_usage_summary(usage: dict[str, Any] \| None) -> str` | One line of token, tool and turn counts for display. |
| `async def handle_slash_command(args: dict[str, Any] \| str \| None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]` | Run a slash command the user typed. |
| `def list_slash_commands(args: dict[str, Any] \| None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]` | The available slash commands with their usage and description, including those the runtime adds. |
| `def make_text_entry(args: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]` | A display entry for a piece of text. |
| `def make_tool_entry(args: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]` | A display entry for one tool result. |
| `def merge_transcript_entry(entries: list[dict[str, Any]], entry: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]` | Append a display entry, merging it into the previous one when both are results of the same tool. |
| `def normalize_transcript_body(value: str) -> str` | Normalise line endings and remove leading and trailing blank lines. |

### Types

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `AnthropicBlock` | One content block of a message: text, an image, a tool call or a tool result. |

## `tess_core.platform_support`

| `async def run_repo_update(args: dict[str, Any] \| None = None) -> dict[str, Any]` | Update a source checkout from its upstream when the working tree is clean, and report each step. |
| `async def store_runtime_secret(...)` | Store a secret under an authorization and return a reference to it. |

### Functions
